planets.name: TOI-1899 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of TOI-1899 with a 29.1-day year, found in 2020.

text.card: TOI-1899 b was found in 2020 by TESS as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around TOI-1899. Its orbit and size follow Lin et al. 2023's fit, the archive's default.
